prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one fixed full-body 2D UHD game character sprite on real transparent background, for Mass Effect Armax.
Reference image: the supplied image is Rion Swanson's in-game Inferno armour presentation from Mass Effect 2, used only to preserve the armour design, helmet, panel shapes, red/black materials and circular joints. It is a design reference, not a multi-view composition to reproduce.
Subject: adult female Commander Shepard wearing the complete original Mass Effect 2 Inferno armour from the Equalizer Pack, helmet on. Produce ONE person, ONE pose, entire body. Keep the deep brick-red segmented cuirass, black under-suit and central abdominal gap, the broad red chest panels, the layered red abdominal strips, red shoulder casings with round dark joint disks, reinforced forearms, red gloves, dark inset vents, transparent smoky gold face visor framed in angular red armour, small red lights. The armour must remain a practical protective suit; proportion it to an athletic adult woman naturally, do not add exposed skin or redesign the armour. Use the original ME2 equipment language for the full leg protection and boots; retain consistent material and panel rhythm. Tiny visible face behind the visor, neutral serious expression.
Composition: portrait 2:3 canvas, body in three-quarter RIGHT-facing fighting-game idle stance, head looking right, arms slightly away from torso, empty hands, feet grounded and separated, 8 percent clear margin above helmet and below soles. Single silhouette. Soft upper-left key light, crisp material edges, realistic adult anatomy, highly detailed hand-painted/pre-rendered 2D HD finish matching Mass Effect character sprites, no exaggerated anime proportions.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency, no floor, no cast shadow or glow cloud outside silhouette, no scenery, no UI, no text, no watermark, no weapon, no duplicate, no animation strip, no reference sheet, no added N7 logo, no Iron Man elements. Preserve the reference helmet and armour identity; changed pose only.
